title: Good app to be fair
body:
Unlimited habitats and ad free which are great, includes a pomodoro timer for focus and a journal tab for daily entries. 

A few things that I would like to see:
1. Bad habits and a counter next to it: Easy fix (just use a normal habit and tick at end of day when you know you havent done said bad task)

2. Sub tasks in a habit: Two or more subtasks that need to be completed for main habit to be completed for the day. For example brushing teeth with require it to be done twice for main habit to be shown as done.

3. To do tasks: One time tasks that are deleted after being completed (or need to be confirmed before deletion to prevent accidental deletion)

These would be nice additions to the app but otherwise a pretty solid tracking app.

title: No scrolling back or trends
body:
App works well enough for tracking a single day but no obvious way to correct/add ticks for previous days or view longer trends (odd - given most research suggests you need a month to form a new habit..)
 I find it quite annoying that I can’t update my ticks/progress from yesterday.
author: eebo-wan

title: It’s a Wonderful App
body: I just really love this app. It fulfils its purpose as a habit tracker perfectly, with a really accessible and visually pleasing design. I love how clear and balanced the widget is especially. The addition of a pomodoro timer for structured work / breaks and a journal for tracking more qualitative aspects of daily life are fantastic too. It has really helped direct my focus to what I want to be doing with my time, which I find harder than most. I am so grateful to the creators for making this available for free, when there are so many cash-grab subscription apps out there, I hope you get the recognition you deserve.
author: Woody.P

title: Best Free Habit Tracker
body: I’ve been looking for a tool to incorporate journaling and habit tracking (in the form of a streak) for quite a while and every app I’ve turned to has required a payment or subscription. This is by far the most intuitive app that not only has an effective habit tracker and streak counter but also incorporates useful tools like a pomodoro timer to focus of work or study. All this and no advertising or in-app-purchases. An amazing tool, I would really recommend!
